findings.message: This array literal has a hole: two commas with nothing between them. A hole is not undefined, it is an absent index, and the difference is visible exactly where it is least expected. `map` and `forEach` skip holes while `for...of` and spread produce undefined for them, so the same array reads as two different lengths of data depending on how it is walked. Almost every hole is a typo for one comma. If the absence is deliberate, write undefined and say so.
